lede.zh: Qwen3-8B BF16 在 910B4 单卡使用 SGLang-CANN 的固定长度测试。
lede.en: Fixed-length serving measurements for Qwen3-8B BF16 on one Ascend 910B4 using SGLang-CANN.

snapshot.zh: 独立实测 · 按负载与采样条件解读
snapshot.en: Independent measurement · interpret with workload and sampling

intro.zh: Qwen3-8B BF16 在 910B4 单卡使用 SGLang-CANN 的固定长度测试。
intro.en: Fixed-length serving measurements for Qwen3-8B BF16 on one Ascend 910B4 using SGLang-CANN.

note.zh: 不同形状的输入输出长度不同，吞吐受负载形状影响；表中值为对应测点结果。
note.en: Input and output lengths differ by workload; throughput is specific to each measured point.

intro.zh: 单卡 TP1、8K 上下文；展示三种固定输入 / 输出形状在 C64 下的已测结果。
intro.en: Single-card TP1 with an 8K context; results show three fixed input/output shapes at C64.

notes.zh: C64 为高压点，长输入的首 token 等待达到数十秒。
notes.en: C64 is a high-load point; time to first token reaches tens of seconds for long input.

hint.zh: 仅显示本配置实测值；缺测点不补零。
hint.en: Measured values for this configuration only; missing points are not filled with zero.

methodIntro.zh: 不同测试阶段的请求形状、样本量和统计口径单独记录。
methodIntro.en: Workload shape, sample count, and statistics are stated separately by test phase.

methodNotes.zh: 不同形状的输入输出长度不同，吞吐受负载形状影响；表中值为对应测点结果。
methodNotes.en: Input and output lengths differ by workload; throughput is specific to each measured point.

methodNotes.zh: 单卡阶段与多卡阶段使用不同工作负载和工具。
methodNotes.en: The single-card and multi-card phases use different workloads and tools.
